## What the public example shows

The example is generated from `template.qmd` on every site build. AU fonts are **not** embedded or downloaded. If you have them installed, your browser can use them; otherwise text falls back to Arial or a system sans-serif font. The Peto section and ending use the AU seal when AU Peto is unavailable.

To compare exact AU typography locally, install the AU fonts or configure `aarhus.font-dir` in your own deck. Public CI checks the fallback experience; private local checks can also verify the official font metrics.
